status_note: Varnode::copySymbolIfValid (varnode.cc:510-522) + EquateSymbol::isValueClose (database.cc:640-659) locked-oracle fixture: isValueClose full branch table, direct copySymbolIfValid on free constants (equate close propagate / not-close reject / plain-symbol dynamic_cast reject / no-mapentry guard), and the op-level markedInput integration through RuleCollapseConstants (op.cc:503-540). Rugra source pinned at the VARNODE-COPYSYMBOL-EQUATE-0001 lease commit that replaced the conservative both-constant approximation with the faithful equate gating.

decisive_semantics.reference_output_parameters: copySymbolIfValid(const Varnode *vn) reads vn->getSymbolEntry() only; mutates this via copySymbol (mapentry/type + typelock|namelock bits, varnode.cc:493-505); isValueClose(uintb op2Value,int4 size) is const, reads only this->value; no output parameters on either function.
decisive_semantics.loop_bounds_traversal_order: No loops in either function; fixed guard order varnode.cc:513-521 (mapEntry null -> dynamic_cast<EquateSymbol*> null -> isValueClose) and database.cc:642-655 (exact equal -> mask -> sign-extension check -> the five close forms in source order equal/~/-/+1/-1).
decisive_semantics.counter_accumulator_lifecycle: No counters or accumulators; both functions are stateless pure predicates over (value, op2Value, size) with no cross-call state.
decisive_semantics.sorting_comparison_keys: No sorting; comparison keys are calc_mask(size) masked equality of value against op2Value, ~op2Value, -op2Value, op2Value+1, op2Value-1 with uintb wraparound, plus the sign_extend(maskValue,size,8) gate on masked-off '1' bits (database.cc:643-649).

analysis_options: none: direct Varnode::copySymbolIfValid/EquateSymbol::isValueClose harness; no decompilation pipeline options

isvalueclose_branch_table.covers: EquateSymbol::isValueClose database.cc:640-659 every branch: cc:642 exact equality; cc:645-649 masked-off sign-extension accept (vc_signext_masked) vs non-sign-extension reject (vc_masked_non_signext); cc:650 masked equal incl. wider op2 (vc_exact, vc_op2_wider_masked); cc:651 bitwise-not (vc_bitnot_close, vc_size8_bitnot); cc:652 negation (vc_negate_close); cc:653 +1 (vc_plus1_close); cc:654 -1 (vc_minus1_close); cc:655 no match (vc_not_close, vc_size8_not_close).

copysymbolif_valid_direct.covers: Varnode::copySymbolIfValid varnode.cc:510-522 all guards: cc:513-515 no SymbolEntry (cs_no_mapentry); cc:516-518 dynamic_cast to EquateSymbol fails on a plain dynamic symbol via Scope::addDynamicSymbol + remapDynamicVarnode (cs_plain_symbol); cc:519-521 close accept propagates markup through copySymbol incl. typelock/namelock-only flag copy leaving mapped clear (cs_equate_*, dst_symbol=1 with dst_mapped=0); not-close reject leaves the destination untouched (cs_equate_not_close).

collapse_marked_input.covers: op-level integration ruleaction.cc:3854-3882 -> PcodeOp::collapseConstantSymbol op.cc:503-540 -> copySymbolIfValid: INT_ADD in0-marked equate propagates to the collapsed constant now input 0 (op_add_marked_close, in0_symbol=1); not-close equate rejected (op_add_marked_not_close, in0_symbol=0); SUBPIECE offset!=0 never reaches copySymbolIfValid (op_subpiece_high_no_propagate, in0_symbol=0).

copy_symbol_high_branch.covers: Varnode::copySymbol varnode.cc:501-504 high!=0 branch (high->typeDirty(); high->setSymbol(this)): Rugra copy_symbol has no high handling at all; the branch is unreachable from the &mut-self signature (Arc identity needed for setSymbol) and this fixture's observations do not exercise it (high-level effects are invisible in the varnode-level mapentry/flag observations).

equate_registry_pipeline_wiring.covers: Rugra equate_symbol_registry models the C++ EquateSymbol subtype identity; database.rs Scope::add_equate_symbol does not yet register its symbols, so main-pipeline equates (XML-decoded or buildDynamicSymbol-created) never reach copy_symbol_if_valid as equates. The fixture registers values explicitly via the public registry API, which is fixture-side glue, not pipeline behavior.

branches.detail: varnode.cc:501-504: copySymbol must call high->typeDirty() and high->setSymbol(this) when the destination has a HighVariable. Rugra copy_symbol lacks the branch; porting it needs the destination Varnode as Arc<RwLock<Varnode>> (HighVariable::set_symbol consumes the Arc), which the current &mut-self signature (locked by the op.rs caller) cannot recover. Fix path: widen Varnode::copy_symbol_if_valid to take &Arc<RwLock<Varnode>> self in a follow-up lease that also owns src/op.rs.

database.rs Scope::add_equate_symbol (database.cc:1712-1725) must call varnode::equate_symbol_registry::register_value for each equate it creates (or database::Symbol must grow a native equate payload) so pipeline-decoded equates behave like the C++ subtype; until then only fixture/API callers register values. Also EquateSymbol::new does not set category=equate (database.hh:306 discrepancy in database.rs).
